answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The orchard is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the nectar. The forge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
